The printable keys of the Croatian layout, other than A-Z and 0-9: what its
keys type without a modifier and with Shift. Built from xkb `hr` and macOS
`Croatian-PC`. Left out, because only one of the two platforms types them
without AltGr or Option: `` ` ``, `~`, `“`, `”`.
